o4saken_chinesebob01.author: punkduck
o4saken_chinesebob01.description: The real author of this asset is o4saken ... I only changed a few vertices and added a new 'base scalp' then I created textures with Blender strands on a transparent background . For the material: best to plugin the color input of the glossy shader to the output of the diffuse texture in cycles. The texture is identically to the O4saken curly01 version. If you allready loaded the hair 'O4saken curly01' and want to save a few mbytes on the disk don't load the textures and edit the .mhmat file instead change texture pathes to hair/ o4saken_curly_dir /o4saken_curly01.png ...

o4saken_curly01.author: punkduck
o4saken_curly01.description: The real author of this asset is o4saken ... I only changed a few vertices and added a new 'base scalp' then I created textures with Blender strands on a transparent background . Be aware that the export of this asset to Blender will fail until the exporter is fixed. The reason is the number of vertices 100000. I will add a text to the 'unofficial plugins' folder with a workaround. For the material: best to plugin the color input of the glossy shader to the output of the diffuse texture in cycles.

punkduck_alpha7_curly.author: punkduck
punkduck_alpha7_curly.description: This is an adaptation of curly hairstyle MH alpha 7 version . The licence was GPL but author was set to unknown. So I consider it CC BY but the author is the MH team. The adaptation was no rocket science. I changed the texture a bit so that the hairline looks slightly better. The example picture is from MH and shows the black material on my 'Evi' character.

punkduck_alpha7_curly2.author: punkduck
punkduck_alpha7_curly2.description: This is an adaptation of curly 2 hairstyle MH alpha 7 version . The licence was GPL but author was set to unknown. So I consider it CC BY but the author is the MH team. The adaptation was no rocket science. I changed the texture a bit so that the hair does not contain skin parts. Furthermore I added 2 materials. The materials are using the litspheres lit_refl_sharp.png in MH. If it does not work use the material editor and change it to none. The example picture is from MH and shows the 'raven' material which I specially made for afro-american females.

punkduck_alpha7_long.author: punkduck
punkduck_alpha7_long.description: This is an adaptation of the 'long' hairstyle MH alpha 7 version . The licence was GPL but author was set to unknown. So I consider it CC BY but the author is the MH team. The adaptation was changing the position and the texture a bit so that the hair looks slightly better. The example picture is from MH and shows the asset on my 'Evi' character. Edit: change color to keep Blender happy
